final_wiki.answer-Q-4184-A62:
Q-4184: How many days are there from 2024-11-05 to 2024-12-10 (count the end date but not the start date)?

Answer: 35

Calculation: Nov has 30 days. From Nov 5 to Nov 30 = 25 days (counting end, not start). From Dec 1 to Dec 10 = 10 days. Total = 25 + 10 = 35 days.
